t: The key to AI Code Assist Acceleration is 1-Folder Scope
s: Leveraging a single 'repos' folder for all project configurations, including NixOS and Vim/NeoVim settings, is crucial for AI coding assistants like Cursor AI to effectively analyze and provide assistance across diverse development contexts. This consolidated scope simplifies AI training and optimization.
sub: NixOS configuration management via Git for versioning and AI scope.
Electron app architecture: Chromium, Node.js, IPC, and web server analogy.
Migrating Vimscript to NeoVim's Lua for improved AI code assist compatibility.
Consolidating diverse project directories into a single 'repos' folder for AI purview.
